bio: Rosa Tommasina was baptized on 5 February 1829 ([R4-S1]). She married Fortunato Ferlaino on 15 June 1851 ([R4-S2]). She was buried at San Mango on 11 January 1889, aged 60, as the daughter of the late Francesco Moraca and Francesca Orlando ([R4-S3]). The baptism index gives her mother as 'Maria' Orlando, but the marriage and burial both say Francesca.
